lines.text: Did your Reverence, Fray Damaso, say that you had been twenty years in the town of San Diego and that you had left it?
Wasn’t your Reverence satisfied with the town?
It must be painful to leave a town where one has been for twenty years and which he knows as well as the clothes he wears.
I certainly was sorry to leave Kamiling and that after I had been there only a few months.
But my superiors did it for the good of the Orders for my own good.
Either Religion is a fact or it is not!
That is, either the curates are free or they are not! The country is going to ruin, it is lost!
He’s in a bad humor because you haven’t treated him with deference.
Sinasabi ng inyong Kagalang-galang, Padre Damaso, na kayo'y nanirahan nang dalawampung taon sa bayang San Diego at kayo'y umalis doon...
Hindi po ba kinalulugdan ng inyong Kagalang-galang ang bayang iyon?
Marahil nga'y nakapagpapighati ang iwan ang isang bayang tinahanan nang dalawampung taon at napagkikilalang tulad sa habitong suot.
Sa ganang akin lamang naman, dinaramdam kong iwan ang Camiling, gayong iilang buwan akong nanirahan doon...
Ngunit yao'y ginawa ng mga pinuno sa ikagagaling ng Kapisanan... at sa ikagagaling ko naman.
Sa makatuwid baga'y, o ang mga kura'y may kalayaan o wala! Napapahamak ang lupaing ito, nasa kapahamakan!
Masama ang loob dahil hindi ninyo binigyan ng Reverencia!
